title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking!

meta.Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Where did my phone go...?
Ah, it was hiding under my pillow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're practicing in SEKAI today, but I have a bit of time on my hands. I think I'll head over early and practice on my own until then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Saki's calling me...?
I wonder why...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <H-Hello, Toya? It's been so long!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Good morning, Saki.
How can I help you today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <So, there's something I wanna talk to you about. Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I have singing practice later today, but we're not meeting for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Great! Then...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Have you already heard about the dinner party?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, my mom mentioned that to me. Your parents are coming over to my house this Sunday, correct?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that! Me and Tsukasa got really excited when we heard the news since the last time we had dinner together was forever ago...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <But our dad said that it's gonna be adults only, so we can't go...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
I suppose they have some business they'd like to discuss, but I was also looking forward to having dinner with you and Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Me too! But, thank goodness! I knew you'd understand!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <So, after talking it over with Tsukasa yesterday, we began thinking about having our own dinner party.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <How about it? Wanna come over the Sunday after next?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To your house?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yup! Oh, but...it's totally okay if you don't want to...! To be honest, we haven't gotten anything ready yet!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The Sunday after next...?
I should be free that day, so I'd be more than happy to come over.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Really? Woohoo!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Oh, I need to tell Tsukasa the good news! He won't know what to do with himself!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for inviting me.
I'll be looking forward to the party.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Same! Get ready to be absolutely blown away! Anyway, see you that Sunday! Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, see you then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A dinner party with Tsukasa and Saki at their house...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's been quite a while...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I still remember very vividly how I always seemed to feel at home over there whenever I visited...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Because I never felt all that comfortable in my own home back then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It happens very rarely these days, but I definitely looked forward to being sent to their house when my parents were busy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I look forward to seeing them again...
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm still a bit early...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For now, I should just head over. We agreed to meet at MEIKO's place as usual...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, hello.
Are you here to practice today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we decided to have practice over here today because it's supposed to rain this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you have plans to go somewhere today, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, to where Rin is.
I promised her that we'd practice singing together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
Wait, what about the cafe...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, about that...
I'm lending it out to KAITO and Len for the day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Lending it out?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, MEIKO!
Can we borrow your kitchen for like a day?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure, but... If it's just the kitchen, you can use it right now if you like.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Now would be bad...
We need it when no one else is around. In other words, we need the whole cafe to ourselves!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, so... That's a secret!
Please, I beg you...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: ...is what happened.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's an interesting request...
Does that mean they're making something they don't want others to see?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I suspect so.
I mean, I can sort of guess just based on the time of year...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
You can?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...
This means we probably shouldn't try going inside today, yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More specifically, An and Kohane probably are the ones who shouldn't be going in.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You and Akito may actually be welcome.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll know once you get there. Hehe. In any case, have fun during practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something they don't want MEIKO and the others to see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What in the world could Len and KAITO be making in there...?
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO said that it'd be okay for me and Akito to enter, but I'm still not sure if I should have...)
Okay, all that's left is to take this dough and let it cool in the fridge!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and we need to be careful to not touch it too much. Otherwise, the butter may melt away.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! Got it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They seem to be making something in the kitchen together... But what...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's it!
Just wrap it in plastic and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Toya! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?! T-Toya?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for interrupting. I heard that you had this place to yourselves today... Shall I leave?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not to worry! Oh, but... If you don't mind waiting a second, we need to wrap this in some plastic first. So, Len, let's get to it...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Phew... Thank you for waiting, Toya. I apologize for us being a little all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
More importantly, that looked like...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: U-Uhh...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were actually just making some cookies.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: K-KAITO, why'd you tell him?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! Sorry, but I had a feeling that he'd find out regardless of whether or not we told him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to spoil your secret.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, no. That's totally fine!
It's actually okay if you know, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But please don't tell MEIKO, Rin or the others. We want to surprise them with these!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Surprise them...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's almost White Day, right?
So, we want to give them some gifts.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it wouldn't be much fun to give them something simple, so I thought I could make them their gifts. KAITO was just showing me how.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Now I understand...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Truth be told, MEIKO is a much better baker than I am. However, they're meant for her, so we can't really ask her to help us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
I hope they turn out well, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me too! Oh, also...
Don't tell Kohane or An too! I wanna give them some too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I promise not to tell them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, White Day...
I'll need to think of something soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you know who you're going to be giving back to, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, I plan on giving back to those important to me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Azusawa, Shiraishi, my mom...
MEIKO, Miku, Rin and Luka.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! It sounds like you also have a lot of recipients in mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I think it's good that you wish to show so many different people how much you appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (People who I wish to show my appreciation for... Now that I think about it, that is a fairly long list...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then, I'd like to give back to them as well...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're even having our dinner party right around White Day, so it can also be my way of thanking them for inviting me.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Toya? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, no... Actually, some friends I've known since I was little invited me over to their house for a party.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I was just thinking that I could do something for them in return.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, you should come up with something really nice for them! After all, we're talking about White Day here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something really nice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree with you.
I'll try giving this some more thought.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It really is wonderful, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me? Why, White Day, of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, even if you wish to show others how much you appreciate them, opportunities to say how you actually feel don't come often, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, having an entire day dedicated to doing just that makes things much easier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For instance, Len here has trouble expressing how he truly feels, but is working very hard in preparation for White Day to make up for his shortcomings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: H-Hey, don't phrase it like that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, just outside the window... Isn't that Akito?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...
It's almost time for us to meet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... If we don't act quickly, Azusawa and Shiraishi will also end up coming here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Len, I'm going to explain what's going on to Akito and try to move our meeting location...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You will? Thanks, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not a problem. So, you two, good luck baking those cookies.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you! Have fun at practice, Toya!
A few days later
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
They really do have a large assortment of sweets and snacks available here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope I'm able to find something that both Tsukasa and Saki will like...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This shop seems to primarily make baked sweets...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Madeleines, macarons, poundcakes and all sorts of other treats.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm not the biggest fan of sweets, but I have a feeling that Tsukasa and Saki will like something from here.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They'll probably end up liking whatever I give to them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, you should come up with something really nice for them! After all, we're talking about White Day here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Something really nice... That's easier said than done.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What should I do...?
Ah, Aoyagi, hello there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Fancy seeing you here.
Were you browsing gifts for White Day?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, you were staring at that display case full of sweets and sighing. It was easy to connect those two dots.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More importantly, you seem somewhat concerned... Were you having that much trouble deciding what to buy?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Wait, Kamishiro works with Tsukasa at the same show stage...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He may be able to give me an insight into what Tsukasa likes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, actually... Would you mind if I asked you for some advice?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I don't mind since I've already finished doing what I came here to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much. Then...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
So you wish to give Tsukasa and Saki something very special.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and you spend quite a lot of time with Tsukasa. That's why I was hoping you could give me some advice regarding him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well... I don't know Saki all that well, but I may be able to help you with Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel that they'd like whatever you choose to give them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it seems like you won't be satisfied with just that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, um... I'd like to get them something really nice. Something they'd both genuinely enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, why not make some sweets for them?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What? Make some for them...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I was actually fortunate enough to receive some homemade gifts for Valentine's Day from my fellow troupe members, and I sort of couldn't believe how happy I felt.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It was a strange sensation.
I tried thinking about why I felt that way...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I ultimately arrived on those gifts being imbued with their respective giver's thoughts and feelings.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Their thoughts and feelings...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. You could even tell that each gift they made was for a specific member of our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, there are countless ways to convey how you feel to others...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With one of them being making something for them. Which I'm sure they'll both enjoy very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
That is a wonderful idea.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But, I...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I did actually think about making something for them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't have much experience cooking or baking... I'm afraid that I'll disappoint them by making something that isn't very good. So, I've been shying away from that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I've begun to change my mind after hearing what you said, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to make something for them that comes from my heart...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, thank you for the advice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome, and good luck.
I hope they like what you make for them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too!
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hmm... There really are quite a lot of recipes for making homemade snacks and sweets.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hopefully, I can find one that's not too difficult, but it also needs to be something Tsukasa and Saki will enjoy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Come to think of it...
What kinds of sweets do they actually like...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I vaguely remember going over to their house this one time and...)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Excellent. They've turned out nicely.
Kids, the cupcakes are ready. Would you all like some...?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I made them not too sweet just for you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Wow! They look so yummy...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Mrs. Tenma baked a lot for us.
All of them were delicious, and Saki and Tsukasa also seemed to enjoy them very much...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Cupcakes...
Yes, that seems like a beginner-friendly option.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, I'll give it a try when I get home from school tomorrow.
The next day
Aoyagi Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay, I've bought everything the recipe said I'll need...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Seeing them all laid out like this... There really are a lot of ingredients involved. And I'm apparently going to need all of them to make my cupcakes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Will I actually be able to...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I don't have time for that.
I need to just give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The recipe says...
“Soft and fluffy chiffon cupcakes that anyone can make!”)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This may be easy for others, but I'm someone who hadn't used a kitchen knife until very recently.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So, I'll need to proceed carefully without letting my guard down...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, place some eggs and sugar in this bowl... No, wait, just the egg whites... How do I do that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see! You can use half of a shell to separate out the yolk from the whites.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hang on... Use half of a shell...to separate out the yolk...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I understand what it says...
But my mind doesn't seem to think that's possible...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Th-There... I cracked it in half...!
Now to use this to separate out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: N-No...! The yolk split in half... And what's left is... There's no way I'll be able to get just the whites out...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... I'll try that again...
se_event_cooking_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This says you make something called a “meringue” by beating the egg whites...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But for how long...?
Will this really turn out as fluffy as what's in the photo for this recipe...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't know, but I'll just have to keep beating...)
se_event_cooking_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, the meringue's done.
Next is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...? I'm supposed to place the meringue in the bowl of yolks and mix them together...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just how much mixing is this going to make me do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All that's left is to let them bake...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, that took up quite a lot of my time. This recipe suggested that it wouldn't take so long...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(And the kitchen's become a mess...
I should clean everything up before Mom and Dad get home.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I followed the recipe as closely as I could, but I'm really not sure how they're going to turn out...)
se_event_cooking_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess they're done.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This looks...completely different from the photo in the recipe... They look considerably flatter. Squished even...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Where did I go wrong?
No, I should taste them before making any conclusions...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here goes nothing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Grimace*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It tastes sweet like some kind of cake...
But this texture... It's terrible. I feel like I'm eating paste...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The recipe said that these should turn out soft and fluffy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know sweets aren't exactly my favorite thing... But more to the point, these cupcakes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They taste awful...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Maybe I aimed too high...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can have someone teach me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO and KAITO know how to cook and bake very well...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As busy as they are, my hands are tied. I have no choice but to ask them for their help...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know it's getting late, but I think I'll go over to see them now...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome.
Hm? Toya? Are you by yourself today...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, for a personal matter.
Is it just you here, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, are you looking for someone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was hoping to speak with MEIKO and KAITO, but I guess they're not here at the moment...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
They're both gone right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO's practicing with Rin and Len, while MEIKO just left to deliver some food she'd made for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I'm watching the cafe while she's out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mind if I ask what you were hoping to talk to them about? If you like, I can tell them later for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I can just come back tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But... Don't hesitate to ask if there is something on your mind. I want to help you in any way I can, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind listening...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Which is why you want to learn how to bake something special for White Day...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Toya, you don't have much experience cooking, do you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. When I tried on my own, things didn't go so well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, that did show me more or less what I am and am not able to handle.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it wasn't all a waste. That's good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway... You're hoping to make some cupcakes, yes? That should be on the easy side in terms of baked treats. At least, I think I remember MEIKO saying something like that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the recipe I found also said it was “beginner-friendly”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Then, that means I could also make them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, Miku, you know how to bake?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've never made cupcakes before, but I think I can since I've been helping MEIKO cook on a regular basis...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was going to ask MEIKO and KAITO for some advice, but I didn't know Miku could also cook.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (MEIKO usually has her hands full running the cafe, and KAITO tends to be busy being Len's teacher...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (On the other hand, if Miku does know how to cook... I may be causing her a bit of trouble, but it may be worth asking her instead.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Miku, if possible...
Would you mind teaching me how to bake cupcakes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, I'd be more than happy to.

rows.Line: No, you're right...

rows.Line: I don't eat sweets on a regular basis, so there really is no way for me to properly judge how they taste.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why didn't I realize this sooner...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, there's no need to beat yourself up over this...

rows.Line:
You're making them with Miku, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
But...

rows.Line: It would be nice to also hear from an independent adjudicator.

rows.Line: Wait, Akito, I know...!

rows.Line: No, don't get your hopes up. Unfortunately, I have work today after school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line: Sorry, I wish I could find you a replacement...

rows.Line:
Uh oh. Homeroom's about to start.
Let's go, Toya.

Kamishiro!
What are you doing in the first years' corridor...?

rows.Line: I was hoping to speak with you for a bit. Remember that little discussion we had regarding gifts?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, about that... After we spoke, I took your idea and decided to bake some sweets.

rows.Line: I didn't quite succeed yesterday when I tried... But I found someone who can teach me and we'll be remaking them today after school.

rows.Line: That's good to hear. I'm sure Tsukasa and his sister will enjoy your gift. Also, they seem to be looking forward to that dinner party you mentioned very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They are?

rows.Line:
Yes, I came here to mention that.
I actually met with him earlier today and...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Cover the beef in salt and pepper... Add vegetables and let it stew...? Hm? You throw in the herbs with it here? The order for this recipe is a little different from the other one I saw...

rows.Line: Oh, Rui! My apologies! I didn't see you! How long have you been standing there?

rows.Line: Only for a second. Also, what were you mulling over just now?

rows.Line: Ah, we've invited Toya over to our house for a dinner party, and I was just reviewing the recipe for the dish we'll be making...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A dinner party...?
I see. That explains why your brow was so furled.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! Since Toya will be visiting, we want to make our party as enjoyable as possible!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Rui, let me hear what you think! I've been trying to decide which of these dishes we should make...

rows.Line: He really couldn't stop talking about you. As such, he's been working very hard to make sure you enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He has...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for telling me this...
Now I feel an even greater incentive to give them something nice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're welcome, and I wish you the best of luck. Also, feel free to ask if you think you need any help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I need any help...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, I wish I could find you a replacement...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Maybe I can ask Kamishiro...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, but... He's busy preparing for a show. Asking him to be my taste tester seems...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, um... So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. You need someone to taste your creations...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since I was the one who originally suggested that you make some sweets yourself. And did I not just say that you're free to ask me for help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I'm not exactly a culinary expert myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I just want to hear your honest opinion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. I should be able to do at least that. So, when do you need me to taste test for you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well, we have tomorrow off...
So I won't be able to bring them to school until next week.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I also have practice with Akito and the others. I'd like him to do this as soon as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I take it you need me to do this soon?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Y-Yes... If possible...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but we can't do much about our day off tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know. If you're okay with it, why don't I come over to your house and taste test for you there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait, but... I'm already asking so much of you... Also, I'm sure you're very busy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
Also, we're not having practice today for our show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But I'll be making them with Miku...
I can't let him see her...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Ah, no... I can just...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, would you mind coming over this evening around six? I'll make sure to have them done by that time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that's fine with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, I'll see you then after school.
I'm looking forward to seeing what you bake.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, thank you very much.
I'll do my best to not disappoint you.
Aoyagi Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...so I've asked an older student from school to taste test for me. He'll be coming over later today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That's good.
Having someone help out should be a shortcut to success.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyway, shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to follow the procedure described in the recipe as closely as we can. However, when I tried it out yesterday, there were several places where I got stuck...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that happens again, Miku, I'd like you to give me some advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Then, mind if I have a look at the recipe?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course, here it is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. Very interesting. So this is how you bake cupcakes. >

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, how did the ones you made yesterday turn out?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, when they came out of the oven, they didn't quite rise the way they appeared in the recipe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On top of that, when I tasted them, the texture felt like I was eating hard paste.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It felt like paste...? Actually, MEIKO did seem to mention something about getting a chiffon cupcake to rise being very important.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<But based on what your testimony...
You may not have mixed them properly.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't mix them properly?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes. Apparently, these sorts of sweets rise differently based on how their batter is mixed.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But they may also have trouble rising if you go a bit overboard.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just how much mixing is this going to make me do...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, now that you mention it...
I did mix the batter for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, in that case, you can try not mixing it so much this time.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You have a tendency to be too careful or follow instructions too strictly. So, why not mix it only a little bit for this batch?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <For example, well... How about two or three times?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That little? Are you sure the batter doesn't need to be mixed more?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I don't think it's a matter of how many times you mix it. You can still mix it fairly vigorously.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Also...
You could try using a little more baking powder.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <MEIKO told me the other day that it's what helps cakes like these rise.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is that what this powder does...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But is it okay for us to put in more than the recipe says...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I think that's up to the individual baker. I mean, everyone puts in different amounts of sugar into their coffee, no?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, it should be okay to put in a little more baking power if you want them to really rise.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that may be so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Actually, this recipe suggests a few additional options... Do you plan on trying any of these?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I was planning to once I got the hang of baking. I even bought some of those ingredients...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Then, let's try putting those in.
You may never get to use them if you wait until you “get the hang of things”.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I am a little worried about going with an alternate option right off the bat... At the same time, I won't learn unless I try.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Plus, I have Miku here to teach me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, then... Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Miku, please tell me right away if you see me doing something wrong...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, I will.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on the address Aoyagi gave me, his house should be just up ahead...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe... I hope his creations are coming along well. I'm looking forward to seeing how they turn out...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excellent! Thank you, Rui!
The menu for our dinner party is all set now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome. I'm glad I could help.
I hope Aoyagi enjoys everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, same here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I was just reminded of something that happened when we were little...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, I never really saw Toya smile all that much back then. He always seemed preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's changed quite a bit since then, but as an older brother figure, I'd like to see him smile more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That explains why you're showing so much concern for him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That is exactly why!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I'd like to prepare a party for him with such spectacular dishes that he won't have any choice but to enjoy himself!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's interesting how Tsukasa and Aoyagi are trying to do so much for each other.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Still, this is their show...
There isn't much that I can do for them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I hope things go well for them...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, this must be his condo...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Kamishiro, hello.
Thank you for coming over today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
They should be ready soon.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let me get you something to drink.
Please, have a seat.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Line: (Now, let's see what he made....)

rows.Line: <The cupcakes seem just about done. I wonder how it turned out.>

rows.Line: (Toya had such a serious look on his face... Probably because he wants the recipient of his gift to really enjoy what he made.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I hope they end up being delicious.)
se_event_cooking_2023_003

rows.Line: <Wait, it sounded like the cupcakes just burst...>

rows.Line: <It must be because they're full of so much energy. I'm sure they're going to be yummy and fun to eat.>

rows.Line: <Are they out, Toya? How do they look?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Line: Well...

rows.Line: They're bright blue... I'm not sure they should be this color... Also, some of them appear to have burst somehow...

rows.Line: Did we really succeed...?

rows.Line:
<Yes, they're a strange color...

rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Line: <I remember hearing a story about how certain cakes abroad can look like this.>

rows.Line: <I agree that they may've sort of fallen apart, but it also means they rose much better compared to last time, no?>

rows.Line: <So, they should be fluffier and more delicious.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Still, I got a completely different result compared to last time when I made them on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As unfortunate as it is that sort of fell apart, but Miku may be right about them tasting better...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... Then, I'll have Kamishiro try these. He also seemed to be looking forward to tasting them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sure. I'm going to head back now, so good luck, Toya.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
I'll stop by SEKAI later to tell you how things went.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I heard the timer for the oven go off just now. They must be done.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe... I think they're finally ready.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
These are the cupcakes I just baked.
Would you mind trying them now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. That's why I'm here, aren't I? Now, let's see what you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What in the world...?!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry. I know they're not all that appealing visually... But I'm sure they taste fine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I suppose so...
After all, it's not good to judge a book by its cover...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: S-So, I'll just have to see how they taste...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Still... This is, well...
Quite a sight to behold, to say the least...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The color alone is making my eyes spin... They're bright blue and purple... And the rainbow sprinkles are making me want to eat them even less...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, the tops of these cupcakes look like they've somehow spilled over. They must've risen far too much while in the oven...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's like a dam burst and released a torrent of poisonous-looking batter...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My mind doesn't seem to recognize these as food... So much so that my appetite from before has completely gone.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I can't tell how they taste with my eyes. I'll just have to hope that they taste okay...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This sandy texture... It's spreading throughout my mouth... What is this? Sugar? Did it not melt properly or something...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But it isn't just sweet...
It's like I'm drinking medicine here and there... It's so bitter...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And some spots on the surface are rock hard, while others are too soft... This is hardly what I'd call a good texture...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I think I can stomach it, but I'd strongly refrain from giving these to someone as a gift...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So...how are they...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe... Well...
In short, they're very unique...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unique...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I'll try one as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Guh...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is...terrible...
I'm so sorry. Please, let me toss those for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, I'll finish them...
You did your best to make these, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Understood...
In return, let me get you something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, thank you. That would be much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
All gone. And thank you for the coffee. That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that was just instant coffee mixed with hot water...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
More importantly, I'm so sorry...
I didn't realize how awful they'd taste...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, they had an interesting taste...
But there's no need to feel so down since you're just learning how to bake.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess this is simply too much for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I failed when I tried by myself, and I failed when I had someone teach me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even if I were to get a little better by practicing, I probably wouldn't be able to make anything good in time for the dinner party...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means I won't be able to put a smile on Tsukasa and Saki's faces...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, at your current rate, you likely won't have a gift ready in time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it's clear that you did everything you could to make the best cupcakes possible.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Above all else, Tsukasa and Saki...
Between your most recent efforts and what you've said, I can tell that you wish to see them smile very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, if you give up now and choose to give them something else, I believe you'll regret not seeing this through until the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that may be so... But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's feeling worse about this than I initially thought... I suppose there isn't much I can do about that since this is his second time failing...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, I never really saw Toya smile all that much back then. He always seemed preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's changed quite a bit since then, but as an older brother figure, I'd like to see him smile more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He wants him to smile more... I may not feel as strongly about that as Tsukasa, but I too would like to see him smile...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you seem to hold Tsukasa in very high regard. You've also known him and Saki since you were all little, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about the time you all spent together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't mind...
But why all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought it would help take your mind off things for a bit. Talking for a moment may help cheer you up, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I may've mentioned this before, but I first met the Tenmas because our respective parents are friends with each other.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd go over to Tsukasa's house whenever my parents were gone, and he'd babysit me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My dad is a renowned classical musician, and he made me study classical music from a very young age...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because of that, I had few opportunities to play with friends or go over to their house...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a result, when I was first asked to stay over at someone else's house, I was very scared...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, as I played with Tsukasa, that fear slowly evaporated... In time, I'd begin to look forward to going over to his house.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... So being able to spend time with Tsukasa meant quite a lot to the little version of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Saki didn't appear in your story. Can you tell me more about how you spent time with her...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I actually didn't get many chances to see Saki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Really?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Saki got sick very often when she was little, so she wasn't always there whenever I went over to visit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, but... When she was home, the three of us would play together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'd read picture books and watch the shows Tsukasa came up with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa came up with his own shows...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that day... I remember how I was heavily scolded by my dad during practice...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Toya seems kinda sad today...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to turn Toya's frown upside down by doing a show for him! You too, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, bring me your horsy plushie!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Okay! Hey, Toya, come here!
Let's watch Tsukasa's show together!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
His shows are really fun!
You'll be smiling from ear to ear after watching it!

rows.Speaker: Little Toya
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Before I knew it, I became so entranced by Tsukasa's performance that I couldn't help but smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Saki was also smiling a lot.
We even discussed how good it was afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To me, those two... And that house...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They have this uncanny ability to fill my heart with so much warmth...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on your gentle expression, I can tell that they mean quite a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, they do...
But did I make that sort of face just now...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I guess that's never going to change...
The time we all spent together... It'll always be a source of encouragement for me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's all the more reason to want them to enjoy my gift...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means I don't have time to be feeling sad...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Kamishiro. I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm going to give this another try tomorrow. I vow to succeed and bake some delicious cupcakes that they're genuinely going to enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to try them when they're done. I'll taste test for you as much as you need.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You will...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even after I made you eat...those...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Especially if it means seeing Tsukasa and Saki smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I hope everything went well for Toya after that... And I really hope that they liked what he made...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting, Miku.
Here's your coffee. Please use as much milk and sugar as you like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I made some fruitcake for a little test run. Would you like to try some...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's very colorful...
Strawberries, kiwis and pineapples. It's very pretty and it looks delicious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's important for treats like these to be appetizing visually...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Appetizing visually...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The cupcakes Toya made ended up looking not very good... I guess it appearance does matter...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I still don't understand why they mushroomed the way they did...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, I did my best to make it as fluffy as possible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, a cake's texture does matter a lot...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Making it soft and fluffy is also one the best parts of baking them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That just means you have to put in a lot of baking powder, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's actually not a good idea. If you put in too much, your cake will likely balloon out of control and fall apart.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, it won't taste very good, and there's a chance of it becoming incredibly bitter.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh no. Did I give Toya instructions that I shouldn't have...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Miku?
You went quiet all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, so... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Toya asked me to help him bake cupcakes as gifts for his dear friends...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know I'm realizing this too late, but I'm starting to get worried...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You taught him how to bake, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yes... Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh dear... She tried to teach him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This... Sounds like it didn't end very well...
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel exhausted. It must be because I tried doing something I'm not used to today...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, I feel terrible about having Kamishiro eat those horrible things...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Still, I want them to turn out well next time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Oh, before I forget...
I really need to thank Miku for helping me...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Toya, are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Miku...? Oh, KAITO, you're here too.
How can I help?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanted to hear how things went today. So, did they turn out okay?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <KAITO also wanted to hear what happened, so he decided to come along.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. I mean, Toya, we were a little worried about you is all.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You were...? Actually, I'm glad you're here. I was just about to head over to SEKAI myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku, thank you for helping me today. I appreciate all the advice you gave me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<You're welcome, but...
Did your cupcakes turn out okay? Did they taste good?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't say that they tasted good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I see...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I wasn't able to put what you said into practice, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, I doubt that was the problem.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <After just speaking to KAITO about this, I realize now that my ideas regarding how to bake a delicious cake weren't entirely correct.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Which is probably the reason why your cupcakes turned out the way they did. I'm so sorry, Toya...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I also feel terrible about the friend you asked to be your taster...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
I know you did your best to teach me, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I greatly appreciate what you did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Toya...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, there's no need to feel so down! Especially since things don't always go according to plan when you're learning how to bake.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, Toya, what do you plan on doing now? Do you still want to bake more cupcakes...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course, since they're for those who are very near and dear to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, I'll help you with your next batch...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You will?
But you're usually so busy, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Don't mind me! I'm sure Len would be totally fine on his own now.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, what does Len have to do with this...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, um... Nothing!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I-In any case, you don't have to worry about me! However, it's getting late, so why don't we try baking in SEKAI tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <In the meantime, I'll ask MEIKO again to see if we can borrow her kitchen!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll be looking forward to it...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Now KAITO's going to help...
I couldn't ask for more.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, quite a few people have been helping me lately...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They've given me so much...
So, for their sake, I need to succeed this time.)
The next day
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, Toya, let's start baking some cupcakes!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck, you two.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us borrow your kitchen like this, MEIKO. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's my pleasure since you've been trying so hard lately. I want to give you all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can do it, Toya!
Also, lemme try some once they're done!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I'll be more than happy to taste test for you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, things are already starting to get lively.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, KAITO, can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind teaching me as well...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The thing is... This has been bothering me all since yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm worried that I'm not as good a cook as I think I am...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because of that, I ended up causing Toya a lot of trouble yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, in order to do a better job of being a teacher next time, I'd like to learn how to cook and bake properly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...!
Let's do our best together, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Yes, I see... Based on your story, Toya, I suspect that the way you mixed your batter has everything to do with them not rising properly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Baking sweets is a delicate art.
As such, even when mixing the batter, you need to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, Miku was right about that...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! She made an astute observation there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, well... There's no way for you to know how to mix them right without learning first.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, we'll keep that in mind as we do this together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In order to make the meringue, you'll need to mix the egg whites while gradually adding in the sugar until you get these peaks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Peaks...?
Yes, I suppose they are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They do look like little mountains. I think they're pretty.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Don't they?
Now, once the meringue's done, you'll put it into the bowl with the yolks...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you'll need to mix it by gently cutting into it and folding it over. Otherwise, you risk pushing all the air out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By doing so, you should end up with a soft and fluffy texture. So, Toya, give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, I'm just enjoying seeing them do their best.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, I should probably get some coffee ready...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, can I have some with lots of milk and sugar?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure Rin, Len, would you two like some as well?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since they're baking a delicious cake for us, I'll need to brew up some coffee to match.
A few days later
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You asking me to meet you up here can only mean one thing. I take it they're ready?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
I finally have something worthy of being taste tested.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is what I made...
I apologize for them not being wrapped more elegantly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, that's okay. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Without further ado, I'll open this up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, they appear to be fairly standard cupcakes...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(At the same time...
I'm staggered by how much more appetizing these look compared to the other ones...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They neither look poisonous nor like they've exploded. They do look a little big and lopsided, but they've been baked to a nice golden brown...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And this gentle but sweet aroma... It must be the vanilla extract. My stomach's growling with each whiff that passes through my nose...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's like a beautiful intertwining of his clumsiness and gentle kindness... They're simple cupcakes, but very heartfelt.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I wonder how they taste...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's find out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... This is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The second I put it in my mouth, I could tell how fluffy and moist it is. What a wonderful texture...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(And it isn't too sweet...
I can feel a slight hint of vanilla passing through my nasal cavity...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, how is it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're very good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You've improved quite a lot. I'm sure Tsukasa and his sister will enjoy these very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, yes... But...
Now that you mention it, I'm starting to get a little nervous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's understandable, but there's no need to feel so apprehensive.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not try thinking about the happiest thing they ever did for you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Didn't they do their absolute best to put a smile on your face?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He may be right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Even that time, those two did everything they could to cheer me up.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Them putting on a brilliant show for me was one thing, but they were just so incredibly thoughtful.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As a result, I find myself awestruck in the presence of those who work to make others smile...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And they're no exception...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Kamishiro...
You've given me a nice boost of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I'm glad to hear that it helped.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also... Please, have these.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know it's a bit early, but they're for White Day. It's a small token of my appreciation in response to all the help you've given me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, this is wrapped rather nicely...
What could be inside?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're also cupcakes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, these are a variant where I mixed in some chocolate. I hope you enjoy them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The one you had me try was very good, so I'm sure I will. Thank you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope Tsukasa and his sister also enjoy your cupcakes.
Sunday - A few days later
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa!
Are the plates ready?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes! The tablecloth's also all set!
How's the food coming along? Will the beef stew be ready in time?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Wait, isn't this tablecloth upside down?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Y-You're right! The tag's in plain view! How could this have happened...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Geez, we need to fix this fast before Toya gets here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-We do... But it's okay.
We still have time until...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
S-Saki! Fix the tablecloth for me!
I'll get the door!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be right there, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Pardon the intrusion.
And thank you for having me today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, thank you for coming over!
We put a ton of effort into dinner, so get ready for a feast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! So, Toya, now that you're here, let us begin our dinner party!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... I have something for the two of you, but I was wondering if I should wait until after dinner...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you have a surprise for us?
I can't wait to see what you prepared.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I'm not entirely sure what's going on... But let's start our party!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank you very much.
That was delicious...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was?! That's wonderful to hear!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the beef stew was particularly good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The beef and vegetables were so soft and slow-cooked to perfection. Also, the broth was rich and filled with so much flavor.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness. By the way, Tsukasa and I made that together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki was in charge of all the frying and stewing, while I was...in charge of washing and chopping the vegetables!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, Toya, how did you like the marinade? Saki did all of that herself, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did? I liked how the onions' natural spiciness went so well with the lemon juice's refreshing flavor. It was very good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hehe. You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, thank you both very much for this wonderful meal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had dinner, how does tea sound?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Toya, our mom was given this really amazing tea. I'll go make some now, so just gimme a second!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
Before we do, I have some gifts for the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, the thing you mentioned when you got here? I wanna see! I've been wondering this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, here they are...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope you enjoy them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, are these...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! Cupcakes! They look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Wait, these look homemade!
Toya, did you bake these?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I hope they're to your liking...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-Whaaat?!
Toya, you know how to bake?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Is that true?! Thank you so much! I feel super duper extra amazingly happy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...
I'm glad you like them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, Toya, where did you find the time to learn how to bake these...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't bake them all by myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had quite a few people help me as I made mistakes along the way. Luckily, I was able to bake something suitable in the end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see... Just for us...
Thank you for putting so much effort into these.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you two did the same by preparing all this for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna go get that tea ready now! I want us to have these together...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well!
Toya, would mind helping me put your cupcakes onto some plates?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, this one has chocolate chips in it... And is this one green tea flavored?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There's so many different kinds!
I'm having fun just looking at them all♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, me too...
Oh! Saki, look! This one has a strawberry on top!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, you're right! I want that one!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, have at it!
However, in return, I'll be taking this blueberry one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Got it. The blueberry one♪
Which would you like, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I'll have... The one with matcha in it. I made one that isn't too sweet for myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Alright, I think we all have one now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Let's thank Toya for baking these and...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Dig in!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, this... This is delicious!
Mind if I try this chocolate chip one as well?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Tsukasa, no fair!
I wanna try it too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, let's split it!
Here's your half!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks, Tsukasa!
Hehe. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, do you want some more tea?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, yes, please...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, this all feels so nostalgic.
It reminds me of the time we had homemade treats when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, yeah! Mom used to bake us stuff all the time back then!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember as well.
All the times we played and had these sorts of treats together when we were children...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Each of those moments is beyond precious to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course, we feel the same way.
That includes today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You made these delicious cupcakes for us and we got to have them together... I can't think of a better way for us to spend time together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope the three of us get to keep on gathering like this! That would make me sooo happy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I! It'd be wonderful to be able to spend time together like this no matter how old we get.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is so strange...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's like nothing has changed since we were little. Every time I come here, I feel right at home...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I used to feel so lonely back then.
I wasn't sure that there was anyone out there who understood how I felt...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But now, I have a partner, teammates and friends who understand just that... Thanks to them, I rarely ever feel lonely.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But...still...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This feeling of being at ease with myself... It's been keeping me afloat all this time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope the gift I gave today makes up for even a little bit of what they've given me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't say for sure, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that they both enjoyed my gift.)
